R1.description: Every Optional finding of every recorded verdict (local and manual, plan and implementation stages, APPROVE or REVISE) of a two-stage item is recorded durably in the item's state at the same transaction as the verdict, keyed by content so a re-raised finding is one entry; nothing else changes

R2.description: Acceptance, by /accept-milestone and by /satisfy-gate acceptance alike, refuses while any recorded Optional finding has no valid disposition (fixed, dropped with a reason, or a follow-up with a link); a follow-up is complete and acceptance never waits for a fix; the dispositions are recorded in a committed completed-milestone record

R3.description: verify and /adopt-gate-policy name the cause when a gate-policy adoption reached the line by a merge commit, with the fix; GATE_POLICY.md states the squash requirement; the evaluation itself is unchanged

R4.description: A plan revision whose artifact declaration leaves a path named in a checkpoint's Files paragraph unclassified at either stage is refused when published, bound or turned into a bundle, with one next step; an absent Files paragraph is an advisory only

R5.description: Release 2.14.0: manifest and its manager block, release constant, release history, downgrade posture and user documentation; the Orchestration Protocol stays 1.4
